title: San Angelo Broadway Academy

services.name: Private lesson
services.desc: Voice lessons are a way to find your individual voice. From beginners to experienced performers, students learn to make the voice more powerful and to use technique to expand range and expression. Lessons cover breathing and support, intonation, sight reading, song study, and warm-up, building a strong, well-rounded repertoire. Instructors build a program around each student's interests, skill level, and character type. Whether you are exploring the piano for the first time or have played for years and want to keep growing, lessons are customized to the student's goals and experience. Students in the private lesson studios perform in two recitals a year. Times and venue are announced closer
